Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have linked your offer to specific input costs and their shares—it sounds like recovering genuine cost increases is your central concern. We respect that need and want a sustainable adjustment for our long-standing partnership, grounded in verified movements over comparable periods. How can we balance price and payment timing to support that shared objective?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. We have verified the decrease in PPI-C241 and your increased volume forecast, which we have incorporated into our revised calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Furthermore, Key Account Management holds full authority for this negotiation; the current offer represents our firm position based on the provided data. The offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our offer is a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Alternatively, at our standard terms: a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. To facilitate a reduction in the unit price to EUR 368.42, we must revert the payment terms to 30 days net, as extended terms carry additional capital costs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

It sounds like a binding commitment, rather than a higher forecast alone, is what would give you the certainty to improve the price. We want a fair, cost-supported agreement that respects your cost pressures and sustains our long-term partnership. How can our commitment and the latest verified copper movement support a further price adjustment?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Your repeated emphasis on committed demand suggests that planning security matters as much as recognising your cost pressures. We want a sustainable agreement for our long-term partnership, without asking you to disclose your internal calculation. How could payment timing help us close the remaining price gap?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our recent orders for Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole were at 348.32 per 1 (po:4500014350-20, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014474-10). What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 361.33 per unit, 30 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have verified the historical purchase orders you cited; however, past prices do not reflect the current cost structure and the significant material increases we have experienced. Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 361.81 per unit, 30 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.

We have verified the slight decrease in the Labour Cost Index you cited and incorporated it into our calculation. While we appreciate your commitment to a long-term partnership, our costs remain significantly elevated due to previous material increases. Based on the verified data and maintaining the 30-day payment terms, we can adjust our offer to EUR 366.55 per unit.

Our current offer stands at a price of €366.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
